February 3, 2026

Your writing goes here. Normal Markdown — headings, code,

print("code blocks too")

links, images, lists, etc.

That’s the whole workflow:

  1. Create a file in _posts/ with the dated filename.
  2. Paste the front matter, set title and date.
  3. Write below it.
  4. Commit & push — GitHub Pages rebuilds, and it auto-appears on /blog/ (newest first) and in /feed.xml.

Notes

  • Drafts: put unfinished posts in a _drafts/ folder without a date in the filename (e.g. _drafts/my-idea.md). They won’t publish. Preview them locally with jekyll serve --drafts.
  • Images: drop them in assets/images/ and reference ![alt](/assets/images/foo.png).
  • The sample post (_posts/2026-06-30-hello-world.md) is just a placeholder — delete it whenever you write your first real one.
  • Math: if you want LaTeX rendering, say so and I’ll wire up MathJax/KaTeX in the post layout (your site doesn’t have it yet).
